characters.continuity: Pokémon Generation I - IX games and anime
characters.summary: Vileplume is a Grass and Poison-type Pokémon that utilizes toxic pollen and powders from its massive petals to incapacitate opponents from a distance. It relies on status-inflicting moves and special grass-type attacks in combat.

mechanisms: Type resistances to water, electric, grass, fighting, and fairy attacks
Status infliction to disrupt enemy actions

weaknesses: Vulnerable to fire, flying, psychic, and ice-type attacks
limitations: Heavy petals restrict rapid movement and agility.

sources.supports: Abilities, type, and combat moves for Vileplume

feats.claim: Disperses heavy toxic pollen capable of causing severe allergic reactions and status conditions.
feats.citation: Pokémon anime and game Pokédex entries

campaignTags.claim: Vileplume possesses wings implicitly capable of flight in certain contexts or Dex entries, though primarily terrestrial.

unknowns: Exact toxicity levels of individual pollen varieties outside standard game mechanics.

characters.continuity: Pokémon Generation I - IX games and anime
characters.summary: Voltorb is an Electric-type Pokémon that resembles a Poké Ball. It fights by utilizing high-speed rolling movements and detonating itself using explosive moves like Self-Destruct and Explosion.

mechanisms: Resistance to electric, flying, and steel-type attacks

limitations: Relies heavily on proximity for explosion-based attacks.

sources.supports: Voltorb types, moves, and explosive nature

feats.claim: Capable of detonating its own body to deal massive explosive damage to opponents.

campaignTags.claim: Voltorb generates and stores electricity within its body.

unknowns: The true origin of its resemblance to manufactured Poké Balls.

characters.summary: Vulpix is a Fire-type fox Pokémon that controls internal flames to project fireballs at its opponents. It uses speed and agility to evade attacks while maintaining ranged pressure.

mechanisms: Resistance to fire, grass, ice, bug, steel, and fairy attacks

weaknesses: Vulnerable to water, ground, and rock-type attacks
limitations: Physically fragile compared to evolved or larger Pokémon.

characters.summary: Alolan Vulpix is an Ice-type regional variant of Vulpix inhabiting snowy mountain environments. It exhales freezing air to encase opponents in ice and maneuver across frozen terrain.

mechanisms: Aurora Veil to reduce incoming physical and special damage

weaknesses: Vulnerable to fire, fighting, rock, and steel-type attacks

mechanisms: Resistance to fire, water, ice, and steel-type attacks

weaknesses: Vulnerable to electric and grass-type attacks
limitations: Limited mobility on dry land compared to water.

weaknesses: Vulnerable to fire, flying, and rock-type attacks
limitations: Very low physical strength and durability.

characters.continuity: Pokémon Generation I - IX games and anime
characters.summary: Weepinbell is a Grass and Poison-type pitcher plant Pokémon that traps prey with acidic fluids and sharp razor leaves. It hangs from tree branches to ambush passersby.

mechanisms: Resistance to water, electric, grass, fighting, and fairy-type attacks

weaknesses: Vulnerable to fire, flying, psychic, and ice-type attacks
limitations: Immobile when rooted or hanging from a vine.

feats.claim: Dissolves any captured prey using a harsh internal fluid acting as acid.

characters.summary: Weezing is a Poison-type floating Pokémon formed of twin connected bodies that generate toxic gases. It uses pollution and noxious fumes to overwhelm opponents in close combat or area-of-effect engagement.

mechanisms: Resistance to grass, fighting, poison, bug, and fairy attacks

weaknesses: Vulnerable to psychic and ground-type attacks
limitations: Dependent on maintaining internal gas pressure to stay afloat.

characters.continuity: Pokémon Generation I - IX games and anime
characters.summary: Wigglytuff is a Normal and Fairy-type Pokémon known for its elastic body and ability to lull opponents to sleep with soothing lullabies. It absorbs impacts and expands its body to deflect physical strikes.

mechanisms: High HP pool allowing it to absorb heavy damage
Immunity to ghost and dragon-type attacks

weaknesses: Vulnerable to poison and steel-type attacks
limitations: Relies on landing status moves like Sing to control aggressive opponents.

feats.claim: Inflatably expands its body to enormous proportions when angered or taking deep breaths.

unknowns: Exact elasticity limits of its fur and skin.

characters.summary: Zapdos is a legendary Electric and Flying-type bird Pokémon that controls lightning and generates massive thunderstorms wherever it flies. It strikes with high-speed aerial dive-bombs and devastating electrical discharges.

mechanisms: Resistance to electric, grass, fighting, flying, bug, and steel-type attacks

weaknesses: Vulnerable to rock and ice-type attacks
limitations: Vulnerable to concentrated cold or projectile rock arrays.
